name: jev-skill-suggestion
description: Keeps the skill listing out of the context window and lets Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, pick at most one skill per prompt. Jev is reached through OpenRouter with just OPENROUTER_API_KEY set (or TypeSafe or the Vercel AI Gateway directly); an OpenRouter chat model is the backup and the engine's built-in classifier the last resort. Also ships a model-router skill: Jev decides what kind of task a prompt is and how much model it needs, and OpenRouter runs it. Based on the jev-skill-suggestion mod from claude-code-templates.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API; preferred over the Gateway, since only it reports a calibrated confidence

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Key for the AI Gateway; with none set the engine's built-in classifier is used instead

provider.title: Backend
provider.description: Which backend to use; "auto" picks TypeSafe when its key is set, then the Gateway, then the built-in classifier

typesafeBaseUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of TypeSafe's own API; empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai

typesafeModel.title: TypeSafe model
typesafeModel.description: Decision model on TypeSafe's own API; empty uses jev-latest

gatewayBaseUrl.title: AI Gateway base URL
gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI Gateway; empty uses https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai

gatewayModel.title: AI Gateway model
gatewayModel.description: Decision model on the AI Gateway; empty uses typesafe-ai/jev

fallbackApiKey.title: Backup API key
fallbackApiKey.description: Key for the backup chat model asked when Jev gives no answer (an OpenRouter key by default); empty skips straight to the built-in classifier

fallbackBaseUrl.title: Backup base URL
fallbackBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for the backup; empty uses https://openrouter.ai/api/v1

fallbackModel.title: Backup model
fallbackModel.description: Chat model the backup asks; empty uses qwen/qwen3.8-flash

fallbackFreeModel.title: Free backup model
fallbackFreeModel.description: Asked when the backup model answers 402 (the OpenRouter key is out of credit); empty turns it off. Free models are rate-limited by OpenRouter

inject.title: How the chosen skill reaches the model
inject.description: "content" attaches the skill's SKILL.md to the prompt, so it loads even when the engine lists it as user-invocable-only or off; "suggest" only names it and the model loads it with the Skill tool

hideListing.title: Hide the skill listing
hideListing.description: Leave the engine's skill listing out of the main conversation's context; off keeps the listing and only adds the suggestion

rerank.title: Re-read the shortlist
rerank.description: Send a second request that re-reads the top skills with their full description and SKILL.md opening, and can reject them all; off suggests the top of the ranking alone

shortlist.title: Shortlist size
shortlist.description: How many of the ranking the second request re-reads

gateThreshold.title: Needs-a-skill threshold
gateThreshold.description: Mean of the three request nouls (acts on the user's system, would follow a documented procedure, prose does not suffice) under which nothing is suggested

fitsThreshold.title: Fits threshold
fitsThreshold.description: A shortlist whose best per-skill "does this fit" noul is under this is dropped entirely

excerptChars.title: SKILL.md excerpt
excerptChars.description: How many characters of each shortlisted skill's body the second request reads

alwaysListed.title: Always listed
alwaysListed.description: Comma-separated skill names that stay in the listing whatever the prompt (the model can still see and call them)

neverSuggested.title: Never suggested
neverSuggested.description: Comma-separated skill names the decision model is never offered; they stay reachable by typing /name

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a decision before letting the prompt through without a suggestion

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each selection to the session log

offload.title: Answer simple prompts with the model router
offload.description: On every prompt, Jev's skill request also asks whether the prompt needs Claude Code's tools. When Jev is sure it doesn't (and it isn't quality-tier or project work), the model router answers it with local Ollama, then free models, instead of starting a Claude turn. A prompt starting with "claude:" always goes to Claude.

offloadTimeoutMs.title: Model router time limit (ms)
offloadTimeoutMs.description: How long the router may take to answer a prompt it took over before Claude answers instead
